written_arguments: The target deficit forces two odd boundary factors and p-2 even boundary factors; each extra boundary index requires an additional quantum-parameter contraction.

Under the strict even gate the factor g^(p-2) is common, so a parameter-small nonzero anchor also works.
A hypothetical finite rational mate defines a finite polynomial system after clearing parameter poles and a common position denominator.
Encode parameter orders and nonzero leading coefficients with explicit factors and inverse equations before approximation; the original arbitrary formal series are not reduced directly.

The finite etale model, residue point, unit equations and polynomial commutator identities spread over finitely generated characteristic-zero constants; good finite-field fibers lift formally and contradict the noncentral coefficient.

The nonperfect reduced constant field k((t)) is handled explicitly: delta^p=0, PBW center C(v^p)[a^p], normalization b=(v/eta)*a, and a truncated-polynomial splitting representation prove central degree p over arbitrary characteristic-p C.
